profile.headline: Senior Solutions Engineer at Databricks
profile.summary:
I am a highly motivated software engineer who is very interested in the Cloud Computing space. I have many years of professional software experience. I am very passionate about helping others design, develop and implement solutions in a Cloud Ecosystem.

Outside of software I pride myself on being a good friend and an older brother. Whether I'm at home in Chicago or out exploring new places, I enjoy being around people and learning from others.

If you need any help developing a solution in the AWS Cloud, please feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Actively contributing to the adoption and implementation of the ISO 20022 standard, enhancing payment systems efficiency and data richness for global financial transactions.
- Delivering a greenfield development project for a Payment Clearing product in JP Morgan
- This is a new project for JPMC Legacy Payment Transformation initiative

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated and enhanced components of our architecture to Amazon Web Services for the Funding Hub in the CIB Payments Technology space
- Technical point of reference for AWS implementation for my team

positions.title: Software Engineer (SEP 2020)
positions.description:
- Acquiring platform modernization effort for Merchant Services in the CIB Payment Technology space
- Delivered a greenfield development project where were we built a modernized funding hub from scratch in a year
- Was the SME for the Scheduling Component of the Funding Hub and successfully delivered a production ready platform with minimal downtime and High Availabiltiy
